title: Gambling for Goals
Immigration, Innovation, and the Geography of Growth
Optimizing Electric Vehicle Infrastructure
abstract: What are the welfare gains from upgrading electric vehicle infrastructure? This paper develops a model of electric vehicle charging location decisions incorporating the transportation network structure, allocation of travel, and the effect on electric vehicle demand. We estimate the model with rich data on vehicle registrations, road segments, cell phone tracks, and charging locations and characteristics. We examine a counterfactual that adds level 3 (direct current fast) chargers optimally in the Connecticut transportation network. We find that adding chargers yields significant time savings and consumer welfare gains, while electric vehicle market shares are only modestly affected.
abstract_zh: 升级电动汽车基础设施能带来多大的福利收益？本文构建了一个电动汽车充电地点决策模型，纳入了交通网络结构、出行分配以及对电动汽车需求的影响。我们利用丰富的数据对模型进行估计，包括车辆登记、路段、手机轨迹以及充电站位置和特征。我们考察了一项反事实情形：在康涅狄格州的交通网络中，以最优方式增设三级（直流快充）充电桩。我们发现，增设充电桩能显著节省出行时间并带来消费者福利收益，而电动汽车市场份额仅受到适度影响。

title: The Impact of Workplace Heat and Cold on Work Time Loss
venue: Journal of Occupational and Environmental Medicine 67(6): 393-399
abstract:
We investigated the impact of workplace heat and cold on work time loss.
Field experiments in different industrial sectors were conducted in multiple countries across all seasons between 2016 and 2024. Hundreds of workers were video recorded, and their full shifts (n = 603) were analyzed on a second-by-second basis (n = 16,065,501 seconds). Environmental data were recorded using portable weather stations. The Workplace Environmental Labor Loss (WELL) functions were developed to describe work time loss due to workplace temperature.
The WELL functions revealed a U-shaped relationship whereby the least work time loss is observed at 18°C (64°F) and increases for every degree above or below this optimal temperature.
The WELL functions quantify the impact of workplace temperature on work time loss, extending to temperatures previously believed to be unaffected.
abstract_zh:
我们研究了工作场所高温和低温对工时损失的影响。
2016年至2024年间，我们在多个国家的不同工业部门、全年各季节开展了现场实验。对数百名工人进行了录像，并以逐秒为单位分析了其完整班次（n = 603）（共16,065,501秒）。环境数据通过便携式气象站记录。我们开发了工作场所环境劳动损失（WELL）函数，用以描述因工作场所温度导致的工时损失。
WELL函数显示出U形关系：工时损失最小的温度为18°C（64°F），高于或低于该最优温度每偏离一度，工时损失均会增加。
WELL函数量化了工作场所温度对工时损失的影响，其适用范围延伸至此前被认为不受影响的温度区间。

title: General Equilibrium Effects in Space: Theory and Measurement
Production Network Formation, Trade, and Welfare
On the Equilibrium Properties of Spatial Models
The Economic Impacts of Clean Energy
abstract: In this paper we assess the economic impacts of moving to a renewable-dominated grid in the United States. We use projections of capital costs to develop price bounds on future wholesale power prices at the local geographic level. We then use a class of spatial general equilibrium models to estimate the effect on wages and output of prices falling below these bounds in the medium term. Power prices fall anywhere between 20 percent and 80 percent, depending on local solar resources, leading to an aggregate real wage gain of 2–3 percent. Over the longer term, we show how moving to clean energy represents a qualitative change in the aggregate growth process, alleviating the "resource drag" that has slowed recent productivity growth in the United States.
abstract_zh: 本文评估了美国向以可再生能源为主的电网转型的经济影响。我们利用资本成本的预测，为未来地方地理层面的批发电价建立价格区间。随后，我们使用一类空间一般均衡模型，估计在中期电价跌至这些区间以下时对工资和产出的影响。电价下降幅度在20%至80%之间，取决于当地的太阳能资源，并带来2%至3%的总体实际工资增长。从更长期来看，我们说明了向清洁能源转型代表了总体增长过程的质变，缓解了近期拖慢美国生产率增长的“资源拖累”（resource drag）。
